subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should raw token, cost, budget, and freshness data become part of `session_status.details`, move to a separate agent-facing usage tool, or remain only on gateway/operator usage RPCs?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the stable API shape controls privacy, cross-session visibility, provider quota semantics, and future agent behavior.

options.title: Add `session_status.details.usage`
options.body: Expose a narrow additive usage object on the existing visible-session status tool, reusing current visibility checks and transcript/gateway parsers.

options.title: Create a separate agent usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-focused and add a new tool with explicit parameters, permissions, and docs for raw usage queries.

options.title: Keep raw usage operator-only
options.body: Leave agents with rendered status text and keep structured totals on gateway RPCs until there is a stronger privacy/product rationale.

recommendation.title: Add `session_status.details.usage`
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow additive usage object on the existing visible-session status tool, reusing current visibility checks and transcript/gateway parsers.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `session_status` and has the strongest history across the tool, status rendering, docs, and prior issue review.
